source.place: Tag 06YN, definition of K-flatness, with the clopen total-tensor comparison and zero insertion.

proof.text: For an acyclic global complex, restriction is acyclic componentwise and the total-tensor comparison transports tensoring to each component, so component K-flatness implies global K-flatness. Conversely, insert any acyclic component complex by zero insertion, tensor globally, restrict, and use the same comparison. This tests all unbounded complexes and includes empty components.

theorem clopen_kflat_detection
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (I : Type w) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{t})
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i)]
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (j i)) (Set.range (j k))))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (j i))
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}) :
    ∀ P : CochainComplex (ClopenData.clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := topology X) (R := R) P ↔
        ∀ i, CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := topology (Y i))
          (R := (ClopenData.clopenTensorRings.{t, u} (j i)).obj R)
          ((ClopenData.clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R).obj P)
